reports.text: Occasionally, but very rarely, you can see a small amount of rocks on the pavement.
A lot of wide and fast turns, beautiful wild scenery.
The first 20-25 miles are crossing a rural area with some interesting views.
So, lots of care needs to be taken - especially on the blind corners.
